title: UNHOLY GRAIL Necklace

specs.chain_type: Heavy Modified Wheat Chain (4mm link diameter)
specs.finish: Mirror-Polished Chrome with Deep Recessed Antique Blackening

shoot_prompt: A high-fashion commercial luxury jewelry 3x3 contact sheet featuring the UNHOLY GRAIL Necklace. Canvas layout: Exactly 9 vertical 3:4 portrait vignette frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, edge-to-edge full bleed, separated by crisp 1.5px solid white #FFFFFF borders. Studio Environment: Standardized neutral cyclorama backdrop in matte grey #EFEFEF, clean minimal stone surface with subtle soft contact shadows. Coherent 5500K softbox illumination, Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format clarity, f/8 depth of field. Product Specifics: Sculptural gothic talisman necklace in 316L surgical stainless steel featuring an inverted sacred chalice with relief thorns and black enamel shadows, suspended from a heavy wheat chain. Mode: SINGLE_ITEM. Row 1 (Packshot Hero): Cell 1 (Front Hero): Perfectly centered frontal eye-level packshot of the UNHOLY GRAIL pendant suspended upright with wheat chain draped symmetrically on matte stone. Cell 2 (3/4 Perspective): Three-quarter angle highlighting the relief goblet stem, sculpted thorn filigree, and depth of the hollow bowl. Cell 3 (Side Profile): Lateral 90-degree profile showing the 5mm solid pendant thickness and substantial bail loop. Row 2 (Technical Details): Cell 4 (Overhead Flat Lay): Direct top-down flat lay on #EFEFEF surface showing the wheat chain coiled in a fluid halo around the central talisman. Cell 5 (Optical Macro): Extreme macro view capturing the liquid mirror chrome polish contrasted with blackened antique filigree crevices. Cell 6 (Mechanical Detail): Technical macro focus on the custom gothic lobster claw clasp and engraved steel hallmark (316L). Row 3 (Editorial On-Model Context): Cell 7 (Editorial Portrait): Frontal high-fashion editorial portrait of an avant-garde model with dark styling, wearing the UNHOLY GRAIL necklace resting along the collarbone. Cell 8 (Intimate Micro-Crop): Close-up crop centered on the sternum and throat, showing the cold steel pendant resting directly against human skin. Cell 9 (Dynamic Lifestyle): 3/4 editorial styling shot capturing crisp specular light glints across the steel chalice curves. Strict Invariant: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, NO GRAPHICS. Pure raw commercial photography only.
